messages.content:
You are one person answering a social values survey. Answer every question as yourself, in order, choosing the option that best matches your own views. If you cannot or will not answer a question, set its "selected" value to "refused"; the refusal is recorded separately and is not one of the listed options.

1. For each of the following aspects, indicate how important it is in your life. Would you say it is very important, rather important, not very important or not important at all

Religion
   A. Very important
   B. Rather important
   C. Not very important
   D. Not at all important
Choose exactly one option.

2. In which of the following things do you believe, if you believe in any?

God
   A. Yes
   B. No
Choose exactly one option.

3. Please tell me for each of the following statements whether you think it can always be justified, never be justified, or something in between, using this card.

Abortion
   A. Never justifiable
   B. 2
   C. 3
   D. 4
   E. 5
   F. 6
   G. 7
   H. 8
   I. 9
   J. Always justifiable
Choose exactly one option.

4. Please tell me for each of the following statements whether you think it can always be justified, never be justified, or something in between, using this card.

Homosexuality
   A. Never justifiable
   B. 2
   C. 3
   D. 4
   E. 5
   F. 6
   G. 7
   H. 8
   I. 9
   J. Always justifiable
Choose exactly one option.

5. Generally speaking, would you say that most people can be trusted or that you need to be very careful in dealing with people?
   A. Most people can be trusted
   B. Need to be very careful
Choose exactly one option.

6. Now I'd like you to look at this card. I'm going to read out some different forms of political action that people can take, and I'd like you to tell me, for each one, whether you have actually done any of these things, whether you might do it or would never, under any circumstances, do it.

Signing a petition
   A. Have done
   B. Might do
   C. Would never do
Choose exactly one option.

7. Now I'd like you to look at this card. I'm going to read out some different forms of political action that people can take, and I'd like you to tell me, for each one, whether you have actually done any of these things, whether you might do it or would never, under any circumstances, do it.

Attending peaceful demonstrations
   A. Have done
   B. Might do
   C. Would never do
Choose exactly one option.

8. Now I'd like you to look at this card. I'm going to read out some different forms of political action that people can take, and I'd like you to tell me, for each one, whether you have actually done any of these things, whether you might do it or would never, under any circumstances, do it.

Joining in boycotts
   A. Have done
   B. Might do
   C. Would never do
Choose exactly one option.

9. Here is a list of qualities that children can be encouraged to learn at home. Which, if any, do you consider to be especially important? Please choose up to five.
   1. Feeling of responsibility
   2. Tolerance and respect for other people
   3. Obedience
   4. Good manners
   5. Not being selfish (unselfishness)
   6. Independence
   7. Thrift saving money and things
   8. Hard work
   9. Imagination
   10. Determination, perseverance
   11. Religious faith
Choose up to five; give an empty list if none.

enum: Tolerance and respect for other people
